sections.title: Welcome, Super Administrator
sections.content: As a Super Administrator you have full control over the UK TCE Admin System. You can manage all colleges, departments, and users; sync course data from SAP HANA; push datasources to Explorance Blue; approve question bank changes; and configure system-wide settings. This guide covers everything you need to know.

sections.title: Dashboard & Key Metrics
sections.content:
Your dashboard shows system-wide statistics: total colleges, departments, administrators, courses marked for TCE, zero-enrollment courses, student counts, and upcoming evaluation deadlines. Use these metrics to monitor evaluation coverage across the university. The Active TCEs Today card shows how many courses are currently in an evaluation window, including total students. The Upcoming section lists the next peak TCE release dates so you can plan ahead.

Quick Actions:
  • Manage Administrators — opens the Admin List page.
  • View Verification Reports — opens the new Verification page.
  • View Zero Enrollment — opens Verification already filtered to zero-enrollment courses.
  • Manage Question Bank — appears only for colleges that have been given Question Bank access.

sections.title: Managing Administrators
sections.content:
Navigate to Admin List to view, add, edit, or remove administrators. You can create Super Admins, College Admins, Department Admins, and Course Coordinators.

Access Flags Explained:
  • D (Dashboard) — grants access to the dashboard and verification pages.
  • S (Static Reports) — grants access to generate static CSV/Excel reports of current system data for sharing or personal use.
  • QB (Question Bank) — grants access to browse, add, modify, and submit changes to evaluation questions.
  • CC (Course Coordinator) — limits the user to viewing only specific courses by prefix/number rather than an entire department. Coordinators cannot edit or submit changes.
Use the Import button to bulk-upload contacts from a CSV file, and Export to download the current list.

To add a user, you select their role, college, one or more departments, and set their access flags. For Course Coordinators, check the "This is a Course Coordinator" box and specify the course prefix and number they should see.

The Level Type setting controls their view: Subject Viewer sees course data; Report Viewer sees aggregated reports.

How to add an administrator (step-by-step):
  1. Basic information — Enter LinkBlue, first name, last name, and email.
  2. Contact type — Choose College for college-level or Department for department-level.
  3. Scope — Select the correct college and one or more departments when needed.
  4. Primary Contact — Choose Yes only if this person is the main college contact.
  5. Access settings — Choose the correct Level Type and access boxes before saving.
  6. Save — Select Create Administrator to finish.

How to add a Course Coordinator:
  1. Select Add Admin.
  2. Choose Department as the contact type.
  3. Check This is a Course Coordinator.
  4. Enter the Course Prefix.
  5. Enter the Course Number only if the contact should cover one specific course. Leave blank to include all courses with that prefix.
  6. After the record is created, you can open that admin's page later and add more course assignments.

Recommended Access Settings:
  • Level Type — Use Report Viewer by default when the contact should not receive additional course emails such as evaluation-start and reminder emails. Report Viewers receive only the email letting them know reports are ready. Use Subject Viewer for contacts who should receive launch notifications, reminders, and closing emails for TCE evaluations.
  • Dashboard Access — Turn on only when the person truly needs aggregate access to the new dashboard. Dashboard licenses are limited, and additional licenses may create a cost. We strongly recommend limiting to 1 person per department and 2 per college at maximum.
  • Static Report Access — Controls access to the PDF reports that colleges have historically used. Static report access is not license-limited.
  • QB Access — Only for colleges actively using the Question Bank feature.

Admin Sync Timing: Administrator changes sync to Blue every day at 4:00 AM. Please submit updates before end of day if you want them included in the next morning's sync.

sections.title: Verification Reports
sections.content:
The Verification page lists all courses with their TCE evaluation status. Key statuses:
  • Marked — the course has been flagged for TCE evaluation. The instructor is listed in SAP as needing an evaluation.
  • Not Marked — the course exists but has not been flagged for TCE. This could mean the instructor is exempt or hasn't been processed yet.
  • Zero Enrollment — the course is marked for TCE but has zero students enrolled. These sections may need to be excluded from evaluations.
  • Active Enrollment — marked courses with at least one student. These are the courses that will actually receive evaluations.
Filter by college, department, term, and TCE status using the dropdowns at the top. Use the search bar to find specific courses by code, title, or section number. Click any course row to see instructor names, student counts, cross-listed course information, and evaluation dates. Items in bold have evaluation questions assigned. Export filtered results to CSV using the Export button.

Quick Filter Buttons:
  • All — the full course list within your current search, department, and term filters.
  • Marked — courses currently flagged for TCE evaluation.
  • Not Marked — courses not currently flagged for TCE.
  • Active Enrollment — courses that currently have students enrolled.
  • Zero Enrollment — courses with zero students at the most recent SAP refresh.
  • Marked & Zero Enrollment — the exception list of courses marked for TCE even though they currently show zero students.
  • Not Marked & Active Enrollment — the exception list of courses with students enrolled but not marked for TCE.
The counts shown on these buttons change based on your current scope and filters.

Verification Table Columns:
  • Course — The course code (e.g., UK 101). Crosslisted courses may show an additional icon.
  • Section — The section identifier for that course offering.
  • Instructor(s) — The assigned instructor list for that section.
  • Title — The course title. Click the title to open the detailed course view.
  • College — The college code tied to the course.
  • Department — The department name or ID tied to the course.
  • Course Start — The instructional start date for the course.
  • Course End — The instructional end date for the course.
  • TCE Start — The date the TCE window is scheduled to begin.
  • Status — Shows whether the course is Marked, Not Marked, or flagged with a zero-enrollment warning.
  • Students — The student count from SAP, refreshed daily.

Course Detail View: Clicking a course title opens a detail page showing: course start and end dates, TCE start and end dates, instructor names and LinkBlue IDs, enrollment count, and crosslisted sections when applicable.

Export CSV: The Export CSV button exports the exact list you are currently viewing — search terms, department selection, term selection, and quick-filter choices all carry into the export. Use this when you need to share a course list outside the system or save a point-in-time review for follow-up.

sections.title: Data Freshness & SAP Sync
sections.content:
Course data is pulled from SAP automatically every day at 3:00 AM, so the information you see stays current.

Important: SAP changes — such as adding or removing an instructor, correcting a course title, or adjusting enrollment figures — cannot be made through the TCE Admin website. Those changes must be made directly in SAP or myUK if you have access. If you do not have SAP/myUK access, contact your college registrar contact. Please allow 12–24 hours for SAP changes to fully populate across the TCE system.

Admin Sync Timing: Administrator changes (adding, editing, or removing contacts) sync to Blue every day at 4:00 AM. Submit updates before end of day for inclusion in the next morning's sync.

sections.title: Syncing Course Data
sections.content:
The system imports course data from CSV files (Courses, Instructors, Students).

Web interface: Go to Verification → Sync Data. Upload your CSV files and click Sync. You'll see a summary of what was added, updated, or unchanged.

Command line: Run python run.py --sync-courses from the server, optionally pointing to a different directory.

Synced data updates the live course listings immediately. The page also shows the last successful sync timestamp so you know how fresh the data is. Previous syncs are logged under Settings → Sync Logs where you can review timing, row counts, and any warnings.

sections.title: Reports — Static Data Reports
sections.content: The Reports page generates static CSV or Excel reports from current system data for any college or department. Use filters to narrow by college, department, term, and TCE status. The report includes course code, section, title, instructor(s), student count, evaluation dates, and TCE status. Use these reports to share evaluation coverage data with department heads, save snapshots for unit records, or perform offline analysis.

sections.title: System Settings
sections.content:
The Settings page provides access to system configuration:
  • Blue Settings — Web service URL, API key, and push configuration for Explorance Blue integration. The system uses these to push administrator and datasource changes to Blue during nightly sync.
  • Sync Logs — Review the history of every data sync. Each log entry shows the source (SAP HANA, CSV, or manual upload), timestamp, row counts, and any errors or warnings.
  • API Key — Manage the API key used for external integrations. Rotate keys here if needed.
  • Changes Tracking — Audit all modifications made to administrator records and question bank entries. Filter by entity type (admin, question), action (add, edit, delete), date range, and user. Use Tracking → QM Changes for question bank audit history. The Tracking → DRA Preview page lets you preview what will be pushed to Blue before the nightly sync runs.

sections.title: Managing Department Admins
sections.content:
Go to Admin List to see all administrators in {{ user_college }}. If you are a primary TCE contact, you can add, edit, or remove Department Admins and Course Coordinators.

Access flags:
  • D (Dashboard) — allows the user to view the dashboard and verification data.
  • S (Static Reports) — allows the user to generate and download static reports.
  • QB (Question Bank) — allows the user to browse and submit changes to evaluation questions.
  • CC (Course Coordinator) — limits the user to specific courses by prefix/number rather than an entire department.
To add a new user, contact your primary TCE contact {{ primary_contact_name }} at {{ primary_contact_email }} with the user's LinkBlue ID, name, required role, and access flags.

Report Viewers receive only the email letting them know reports are ready. Use Subject Viewer for contacts who should receive launch notifications, reminders, and closing emails for TCE evaluations.

sections.title: Approving Question Changes
sections.content:
Department Admins with QB access can submit proposed changes to evaluation questions. As a College Admin or primary contact, you are responsible for reviewing and approving these changes.

You will receive notifications when changes are submitted. Go to Question Bank → Pending to see all outstanding submissions for your college. Review each change carefully — you'll see what's being added, modified, or removed.

Approved changes are finalized and go live in the next Blue push. Rejected changes are returned to the submitter with a note. Use Tracking → QB/QM Changes to audit all changes over time.

Important: Changes submitted by regular department admins are not final until you approve them. Always review before approving.

sections.title: Question Bank — How to Drill Down
sections.content:
The Question Bank loads with all courses collapsed. To find questions for a specific course:
  1. Go to Question Bank → Browse.
  2. Click a college name to expand it and see its departments.
  3. Click a department to expand it and see its courses.
  4. Click a course to expand it and see its sections.
  5. Click a section to see its assigned questions.
Each course has two tabs: Instructor Questions (evaluation questions about the instructor) and Course Questions (evaluation questions about the course itself). Use the Term dropdown to switch between academic terms. Questions that have been added are shown with their type (Selection or Comment), text, and options.

sections.title: Adding Users — Primary Contact How-To
sections.content:
If you are a primary TCE contact for {{ user_college }}, you can add new administrators.

How to add an administrator:
  1. Go to Admin List → Add Administrator.
  2. Enter the user's LinkBlue ID, First Name, Last Name, and Email.
  3. Choose Contact Type: College for college-level or Department for department-level.
  4. Select the correct College and one or more Departments when needed.
  5. Choose Primary Contact: Yes only if this person is the main college contact.
  6. Choose Level Type: Subject Viewer for course-level access with evaluation emails; Report Viewer for report-only access without additional course emails.
  7. Set access flags (Dashboard, Static Reports, Question Bank) as needed.
  8. Select Create Administrator to save.

How to add a Course Coordinator:
  1. Select Add Admin.
  2. Choose Department as the contact type.
  3. Check This is a Course Coordinator.
  4. Enter the Course Prefix (e.g., UK, BAE).
  5. Enter the Course Number only if the contact should manage one specific course. Leave blank to include all courses with that prefix.
  6. After the record is created, you can open that admin's page later and add more course assignments.
Edit, Copy, or Remove:
  • Edit — use when the same person is keeping access but their role, departments, or settings need to change.
  • Copy — useful when a new person should inherit a similar setup.
  • Remove — deactivates the admin record when access should end.

Admin Sync Timing: Administrator changes sync to Blue every day at 4:00 AM. Submit updates before end of day for inclusion in the next morning's sync.

sections.title: FAQ — Common Questions
sections.content:
Can I see courses that are not marked for TCE?
Yes. The new Verification page includes both marked and not-marked courses, and the quick filters make it easy to isolate either group.

Where do the student counts come from?
Student counts are pulled from SAP and refreshed daily. The counts shown on the Dashboard and Verification page reflect the most recent refresh.

What should I look at first in Verification?
Start with Not Marked & Active Enrollment and Marked & Zero Enrollment. Those are the fastest ways to spot possible issues.

What does Export CSV include?
It exports the list exactly as filtered on screen, including your search, department, term, and quick-filter selections.

When should I use Report Viewer?
Use Report Viewer when a contact should receive the report-ready communication but not the additional course evaluation start and reminder emails.

When do admin changes reach Blue?
Administrator changes sync daily at 4:00 AM. Please enter changes before end of day for the next morning's sync.

sections.title: Welcome, Department Administrator
sections.content: As a Department Administrator you can view course data, verify evaluation coverage, and (if you have QB access) submit changes to evaluation questions for your department. This guide covers your role.

sections.title: Dashboard (Scoped to Your Department)
sections.content: Your dashboard shows your department's courses marked for TCE, zero-enrollment courses, and student counts. Use it for a quick health check of your department's evaluation status.

sections.title: Verification Reports
sections.content:
The Verification page shows courses in your department with TCE status. Key statuses:
  • Marked — flagged for evaluation.
  • Not Marked — not flagged.
  • Zero Enrollment — flagged but no students enrolled.
Filter by term and status. Search by course code, title, or section number. Items in bold have evaluation questions assigned. Export to CSV.

Quick Filter Buttons:
  • All — full course list within your current filters.
  • Marked — courses currently flagged for TCE.
  • Not Marked — courses not currently flagged.
  • Active Enrollment — courses with students enrolled.
  • Zero Enrollment — courses with zero students at the most recent SAP refresh.
  • Marked & Zero Enrollment — courses marked for TCE but currently showing zero students.
  • Not Marked & Active Enrollment — courses with students enrolled but not marked for TCE.

  • Course — The course code.

Course Detail View: Clicking a course title shows: course start/end dates, TCE start/end dates, instructor names and LinkBlue IDs, enrollment count, and crosslisted sections.

sections.title: Verification — Drill-Down & Export
sections.content: Click any course title to see full details: instructor names, student counts, cross-listed courses, and evaluation dates. Use the Export CSV button to download your current filtered view — all active filters (search, term, status, quick-filter) are included in the export. Use this to share data with your department head or keep a point-in-time record.

sections.content:
Course data is pulled from SAP automatically every day at 3:00 AM, so the information you see stays current. SAP changes (instructor changes, course title corrections, enrollment adjustments) cannot be made through the TCE Admin website. Those changes must be made in SAP or myUK if you have access, or by contacting your college registrar contact. Allow 12–24 hours for SAP changes to fully populate.

sections.title: Reports — Static Data Reports
sections.content: The Reports page generates static CSV or Excel reports from current system data for your department. Use filters to narrow by term and TCE status. The report includes course code, section, title, instructor(s), student count, evaluation dates, and TCE status. Use these reports to share evaluation coverage data with your department head, save snapshots for unit records, or perform offline analysis. The reports reflect the current state of the data in the system.

sections.title: Submitting Question Changes
sections.content:
If you have Question Bank access, you can browse your department's evaluation questions and submit changes.

How to find questions: Go to Question Bank → Browse. Courses load collapsed. Click your college, then your department, then a course, then a section to drill down to its questions. Each course shows Instructor Questions and Course Questions in separate tabs.

To add a question: click Add Question, choose the type (Selection or Comment), fill in the text and options, and submit. To modify or delete: use the edit or delete icons next to each existing question.

Visual Feedback on Pending Changes: After you submit a change, you'll see visual indicators in the Question Bank showing your pending changes. This helps you avoid submitting duplicate requests!
  • Pending Addition — Green highlighted background with the new question text and a note: "Awaiting approval — this question will be added once approved."
  • Pending Removal — Strikethrough text with a red-tinted background and a note: "Awaiting approval — this question will be removed once approved."
  • Pending Edit — Old text shown struck through, new text highlighted, with a note: "Awaiting approval — changes shown above will be applied once approved."

Viewing Your Pending Requests: Click the My Pending Requests button in the top right corner of the Question Bank page. This page shows: all your submitted change requests, the type of each change (Add, Edit, Remove), when you submitted each request, and the question text affected.

Important: Your changes are submitted for approval — they are not final until your primary TCE contact ({{ primary_contact_name }}) reviews and approves them. You cannot approve your own changes. Check the status of your submissions on the Pending page.

sections.title: Adding Users
sections.content: Only primary TCE contacts and OFA staff can add, edit, or delete users. To request a new Department Admin or Course Coordinator for your department, contact your college's primary TCE contact {{ primary_contact_name }} at {{ primary_contact_email }}. Provide the user's LinkBlue ID, full name, and the access level they need (Dashboard, Static Reports, and/or Question Bank).

How do I check the status of my question submissions?

sections.title: Course Coordinator — Limited View
sections.content: As a Course Coordinator you can view TCE evaluation data only for the specific courses assigned to you. You cannot edit questions, submit changes, or manage other users. Your view is filtered to your assigned course prefix and number(s). Your primary contact for {{ user_college }} is {{ primary_contact_name }}.

sections.title: Data Freshness & SAP Sync
sections.content: Course data is pulled from SAP automatically every day at 3:00 AM. SAP changes — such as adding or removing an instructor — cannot be made through the TCE Admin website. Those changes must be made directly in SAP or myUK if you have access, or by contacting your college registrar contact. Please allow 12–24 hours for SAP changes to fully populate across the TCE system.

sections.title: Viewing Your Courses
sections.content: Go to Verification to see your assigned courses. The list is automatically filtered to show only courses matching your prefix and number. You can see student counts, instructor names, evaluation dates, and TCE status for each section. Use the search bar to find specific sections, or filter by term to switch between academic terms. Click any course title to see full details including course dates, TCE dates, instructor names and LinkBlue IDs, enrollment count, and crosslisted sections.

sections.title: What You Cannot Do
sections.content: As a Course Coordinator you do not have access to: adding or removing questions, submitting question bank changes, approving changes, managing other users, generating reports, or accessing system settings. If you need additional access, contact your college's primary TCE contact {{ primary_contact_name }} at {{ primary_contact_email }}.

sections.title: Question Bank Access — Overview
sections.content: You have Question Bank access, which allows you to browse, add, modify, and submit changes to evaluation questions for courses in your department. This section explains how to use the Question Bank effectively.

sections.title: Browsing & Drilling Down
sections.content:
Go to Question Bank → Browse. Questions are organised hierarchically: College → Department → Course → Section. All levels start collapsed.

To find questions:
  1. Click your college name to expand it and see its departments.
  2. Click your department to expand it and see its courses.
  3. Click a course to expand it and see its sections (e.g., CS215-001, CS215-002).
  4. Click a section to see its assigned evaluation questions.
Use the Term dropdown at the top to switch between academic terms (e.g., Spring 2026 vs. Fall 2026). Each course displays two tabs: Instructor Questions (questions about the instructor's teaching) and Course Questions (questions about the course content and structure).

sections.title: Adding, Modifying & Deleting Questions
sections.content:
To add a new question: Navigate to a course section, click the Add Question button. Choose the question type: Selection (multiple choice — you provide the options) or Comment (open-ended text response). Fill in the question text and any options, then submit.

To modify an existing question: Click the edit icon (pencil) next to the question. Change the text, type, or options, then save.

To delete a question: Click the delete icon (trash) next to the question. Confirm the deletion.

Important: All changes you submit are pending approval. Your primary TCE contact ({{ primary_contact_name }}) must review and approve each change before it goes live. You will not see your changes reflected in Blue until they are approved.

sections.title: Understanding Visual Feedback on Pending Changes
sections.content:
After you submit a change request, you'll see visual indicators in the Question Bank showing your pending changes. This helps you avoid submitting duplicate requests!

Pending Addition (green highlighted background):
The new question appears with a green background and a badge reading "Pending Addition." A note underneath says: "Awaiting approval — this question will be added once approved."

Pending Removal (strikethrough text, red-tinted background):
The question marked for removal shows strikethrough text on a red-tinted background with a "Pending Removal" badge. A note says: "Awaiting approval — this question will be removed once approved."

Pending Edit (old text struck through, new text highlighted):
The old text appears struck through, the new text appears in a highlighted box below it with an arrow indicator, and a "Pending Edit" badge. A note says: "Awaiting approval — changes shown above will be applied once approved."

Viewing Your Pending Requests: Click the My Pending Requests button in the top right corner of the Question Bank page to see all your submitted change requests in one place. The page shows: the type of each change (Add, Edit, Remove), when you submitted each request, and the question text affected.

sections.title: Approval Workflow — What Happens to Your Changes
sections.content:
When you submit a change (add, modify, or delete a question), it enters an approval workflow:
  1. Your change is saved in a Pending state.
  2. Your primary TCE contact ({{ primary_contact_name }}) is notified.
  3. They review your change and either Approve or Reject it.
  4. If approved, the change is finalised and pushed to Explorance Blue in the next sync.
  5. If rejected, the change is returned with a note — you can revise and resubmit.
You can check the status of your submissions on the Question Bank → Pending page. Changes from other admins in your department are visible on the All Pending tab.

Note: You cannot approve your own changes — only primary contacts and Super Admins can approve.

sections.title: Best Practices
sections.content:
• Check before submitting — Look for visual indicators to see if you've already requested a change. Avoid submitting duplicate requests.
  • Preview your changes before submitting — once approved, questions go live in the next Blue push.
  • Coordinate with instructors to ensure question text is accurate and matches what they want evaluated.
  • Use descriptive question text — clear, specific questions yield better evaluation feedback.
  • Check existing questions first before adding duplicates — drill down to the section level to see what's already assigned.
  • If you make a mistake, submit a correction — it will go through the same approval workflow.
  • Review regularly — check your "My Pending Requests" page to track your submissions.
  • Be patient with approvals — your primary contact may have many submissions to review across the college.
